projects.name: Heart Flow - Contract Intelligence Agent | Agentic AI System
projects.description:
Heart Flow - Contract Intelligence Agent | Agentic AI SystemDeveloped a sophisticated contract analysis and metadata extraction agent using Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) forenterprise legal document processing.
Document Discovery & Pagination: Implemented intelligent document search with word-matching algorithms andpagination support, enabling efficient retrieval from large document repositories
LLM-Based Metadata Extraction: Built an intelligent metadata extraction pipeline that processes PDF contracts andautomatically identifies key entities: client names, service providers, dates, contract terms, and signatory information
Smart Document Selection: Implemented multi-criteria document ranking logic that prefers final/executed versions overdrafts, selects the highest version numbers, and prioritises most recent dates for accurate analysis
GCS Integration: Seamlessly integrated Google Cloud Storage for document access and retrieval with robust error handlingand format validation
Scalable Architecture: Designed a pagination-based approach for handling large document collections (100K+ files) withoutperformance degradation
RAG-Ready Output: Generates structured JSON output with complete contract metadata for downstream RAG systems andcompliance workflows

projects.name: HealthEdge Guiding Care Bot | Multi-Agent System
projects.description:
HealthEdge Guiding Care Bot | Multi-Agent System Developed an advanced multi-agent AI assistant using Python, OpenAI, and LangChain for automated ticket managementand customer support.
Implemented conversational agent workflows with specialized roles for ticket classification, response generation, andescalation handling
Developed responsive React.js UI components with real-time agent communication display
Engineered Node.js middleware with advanced API security, authentication, and rate limiting
Engineered data integration system incorporating Confluence pages, HTML dumps, and video content
Enhanced search capabilities using Azure AI Search Service and advanced prompt systems

projects.name: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals Target PPM Bot
projects.description:
Regeneron Pharmaceuticals Target PPM BotBuilt a conversational AI bot using Python, LangChain, and OpenAI models
Implemented the Milvus vector database for efficient embedding, storage, and semantic search
Created end-to-end RAG pipeline from data ingestion to contextual response generation
Deployed solution as ML-Flow model and converted to REST API using Dataiku Platform
Implemented context-aware conversation management with memory persistence

projects.name: Essay Writer with LangGraph Multi-Agent System
projects.description:
Essay Writer with LangGraph Multi-Agent System GitHub:
github.com/av525/essay-writer-langgraphDeveloped a multi-agent AI system using LangGraph for automated essay writing with specialized agent collaboration
Implemented 5-agent workflow: Planner, Researcher, Writer, Critic, and Research Critic agents for iterative contentimprovement & Integrated Tavily API for real-time web research and Azure OpenAI for content generation.
Built Streamlit web interface with real-time execution tracking and configurable revision cycles
Designed state management system using LangGraph for persistent workflow orchestration

projects.name: AI Customer Support with AutoGen Conditional Nested Chat
projects.description:
AI Customer Support with AutoGen Conditional Nested ChatGitHub:
github.com/av525/ai-customer-supportArchitected sophisticated customer support application using AutoGen Conditional Nested Chat Architecture
Implemented intelligent agent routing with 4 specialized agents: Support Coordinator, Response Agent, TroubleshootingAgent, and Escalation Agent
Built conditional workflow system where agents are activated based on inquiry type and complexity
Developed real-time processing visualization with live agent flow tracking and performance monitoring
